assets: lucide-react@1.55.0 (icons imported in apps/web/src, modules, packages)

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background of the main column and the topbar; also the fill of text fields, outline buttons and unchecked checkboxes.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on background, surface, card, muted and every -soft tint (12.6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Second ground: the desktop sidebar and table header rows. One step off background, never a card.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised panels: Card, Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu and toasts. In light it equals background, so the border and shadow set the card apart.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card (same values as foreground).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: secondary buttons, hover on ghost buttons, menu items and nav links, the progress track, skeletons, Kbd, inline code and code blocks, the neutral badge.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, hints, table headers, inactive nav links, placeholders, the neutral badge. 6.0–6.7:1 on background, surface, card and muted in light; 6.2–7.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: cards, tables, dividers, the sidebar and topbar edges, dashed empty states. Decorative (1.25:1 / 1.42:1), never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of text fields, selects, pickers, file fields and outline buttons. Kept exactly as the source has it: 1.40:1 on background in light and 1.78:1 in dark, below the 3:1 a control border should reach.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The site's brand colour: primary buttons, the active nav item and tab underline, links, selected and today's day, progress fill, unread counters, checked checkboxes. Generated per site from branding.accent (default #4f46e5) by palette.ts; globals.css falls back to #8b8cf6 in dark. 6.3:1 on background and 5.6:1 on accent-soft in light; 7.3:1 and 6.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills: primary buttons, the selected day, counters, the logo tile (6.3:1 light, 7.4:1 dark). Dark text in dark, never white. globals.css fallback in dark: #15161c.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint: the active sidebar item, the info alert, the accent badge and avatar initials. Text on it is accent or foreground. globals.css fallback: #eef0fe / #262842.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element; follows the accent (palette.ts sets ring = accent). 5.9:1 or more on background, surface and card in light; 6.6:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, error text under fields, invalid field borders, the destructive badge (text on destructive at 10% over background: 4.8:1 light, 5.7:1 dark). 5.6:1 on background in light, 6.5:1 in dark.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive fills (5.6:1 light, 6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons, on success-soft or background (5.8:1 and 6.5:1 light; 7.4:1 and 9.6:1 dark). Always paired with a word: success and destructive differ mostly by hue.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success tint: the success alert, badge and toast.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons, on warning-soft or background (5.9:1 and 6.5:1 light; 7.8:1 and 10.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tint: the warning alert, badge and toast.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs (black at 40%, with a 1px blur), in both themes.

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page: PageHeader's h1 (text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: CardTitle and section headings inside a page (text-base font-semibold leading-tight).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You are not enrolled in any course yet
styles.usage: The UI's default size (text-sm): fields, tables, alerts, menu items, descriptions.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, tab links, table headers and option labels (text-sm font-medium).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Large buttons (size lg adds text-base) and empty-state titles at 400–500.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Unique; used in lists and reports
styles.usage: Field hints and errors, dropdown labels, the version line in the sidebar (text-xs).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badge text (text-xs font-medium) and sidebar counters.

styles.name: nav-bottom
styles.usage: Labels in the mobile bottom navigation (text-[11px]), truncated to one line.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: Unread counters over bottom-nav icons (text-[10px] leading-4).

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Read the chapter before the seminar.
styles.usage: Text authored in the editor (.prose-content): inherits its size, paragraphs 0.6em apart.

styles.name: prose-h2
styles.usage: h2 in course content, 1.2em above and 0.4em below.

styles.name: prose-h3
styles.usage: h3 in course content, 1em above and 0.3em below.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks in course content, on muted.

spacing.note: Every padding, gap and size in the components is a multiple of `spacing` (Tailwind's --spacing). Editing `spacing` rescales them; the steps below document the multiples the components use.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: The unit (4px). Every Tailwind step multiplies it: px-3 = 3 × spacing.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Badge and Kbd vertical padding (py-0.5).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Menu panel padding (p-1), gaps inside badges and between sidebar links, label-to-description gap in dialogs.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Label-to-control gap in Field (gap-1.5), menu item vertical padding, popover and dropdown offset from the trigger.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in buttons and menu items, dialog footer and header action gaps, table cell top padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding (py-2.5).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field and table cell horizontal padding (px-3), small buttons, sidebar padding and nav icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Medium button and alert horizontal padding, gaps between page-header blocks, dialog grid gap, the mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (p-5; header pb-3, content pt-0).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large button padding, dialog padding (p-6), space under PageHeader and LinkTabs (mb-6), the desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding (py-12).

radius.note: The source derives sm, md, lg and xl from one --radius of 0.625rem (sm = radius − 4px, md = radius − 2px, xl = radius + 4px).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd and the file field's inner button (rounded).

tokens.name: radius-checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkboxes (radios are round).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The dialog close button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, alerts, menu items, nav links, calendar days, skeletons (rounded-md); also code blocks and images in course content.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, popovers, dropdown panels, empty states, the logo tile (rounded-lg) — the source's --radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs (rounded-xl).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, avatars, counters, the progress bar and radios.

shadow.note: Shadows are faint and the same in both themes; borders do most of the separating.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Primary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Floating layers: dialogs, popovers, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg

tokens.name: size-topbar

tokens.name: size-content
